synopsis: A few weeks after the Blood Knights’ founding, Falanaras and Theron are well into training within the new order: named, uniformed in black and crimson, and learning to wield stolen Light as disciplined soldiers rather than traditional paladins. Reports of Amani movement and disturbed Scourge forces send Liadrin’s Blood Knights south with Lethira’s rangers toward the runestone boundary while the Ghostlands remain wholly hostile territory. They make the hard march before meeting Serenya Duskrunner near the boundary. Her scouts reveal that the Amani drove a host north along the Dead Scar too quickly for interception; the undead have already crossed the restored runestone line into southern Eversong. The combined forces ride directly into battle. Falanaras fights as an offensive two-handed swordsman and Theron as a shield-bearing protector, while the order reveals devastating anti-undead force, healing, and defense. When Serenya’s scouts are cut off on the Scourge flank, Lethira accepts her old friend’s field judgment and Falanaras covers their withdrawal; the Forsaken repay the protection by exposing the control line and pulling wounded rangers clear. The incursion is destroyed inside Eversong, but the victory does not reclaim the Ghostlands or Tranquillien. Blood elves hold the northern side of the boundary and the Forsaken return south, leaving only a practical precedent for future cooperation.
title: Chapter 12: Blood and Light
